title: QSR16: binary exact stream with explicit square-root time exponent

claims.statement: For QSR16 in the evidence, every N>=2 and s modulo N, n=ceil(log2N), the SAME fixed program (exhaustive n<2^24, otherwise m=2,R=ceil((23/32)sqrt(n)) exact stream ranks with known-frequency recovery) recovers the entire secret with unconditional probability>2/3. On EVERY branch T=O(n^(9983/1058)2^((1041/368)sqrt(n))), jointly with all other resources and clean law. Growth index 1/2. All outside constants are absolute, every preparation/filter/retry/bit/address/gate/controller/monitor/inverse/cleanup is charged. The representative applies for n>=2 with n=1 fixed; the finite prefix is explicitly included without a hidden inner O coefficient.

For QSR16 in the evidence, every N>=2 and s modulo N, n=ceil(log2N), the SAME fixed program (exhaustive n<2^24, otherwise m=2,R=ceil((23/32)sqrt(n)) exact stream ranks with known-frequency recovery) recovers the entire secret with unconditional probability>2/3. On EVERY branch S_C=O(n^(3/2)2^((23/32)sqrt(n))), jointly with all other resources and clean law. Growth index 1/2. All outside constants are absolute, every preparation/filter/retry/bit/address/gate/controller/monitor/inverse/cleanup is charged. The representative applies for n>=2 with n=1 fixed; the finite prefix is explicitly included without a hidden inner O coefficient.

For QSR16 in the evidence, every N>=2 and s modulo N, n=ceil(log2N), the SAME fixed program (exhaustive n<2^24, otherwise m=2,R=ceil((23/32)sqrt(n)) exact stream ranks with known-frequency recovery) recovers the entire secret with unconditional probability>2/3. On EVERY branch S_Q=O(n), jointly with all other resources and clean law. Growth index 0. All outside constants are absolute, every preparation/filter/retry/bit/address/gate/controller/monitor/inverse/cleanup is charged. The representative applies for n>=2 with n=1 fixed; the finite prefix is explicitly included without a hidden inner O coefficient.

For QSR16 in the evidence, every N>=2 and s modulo N, n=ceil(log2N), the SAME fixed program (exhaustive n<2^24, otherwise m=2,R=ceil((23/32)sqrt(n)) exact stream ranks with known-frequency recovery) recovers the entire secret with unconditional probability>2/3. On EVERY branch Q=O(n^(2082/529) 2^((32/23)sqrt(n))), jointly with all other resources and clean law. Growth index 1/2. All outside constants are absolute, every preparation/filter/retry/bit/address/gate/controller/monitor/inverse/cleanup is charged. The representative applies for n>=2 with n=1 fixed; the finite prefix is explicitly included without a hidden inner O coefficient.

For QSR16 in the evidence, every N>=2 and s modulo N, n=ceil(log2N), the SAME fixed program (exhaustive n<2^24, fixed binary exact stream-ranking tree otherwise, keeping all known W for odd-part recovery and only odd W for two-adic parity) recovers the entire secret with unconditional probability>2/3. For the ACTUAL acquired-copy count Q, including all failed filters and discarded trees, guaranteed malformed-copy count is tau(n,Q)=0. All copies must be independent ideal coset states; no positive-corruption guarantee or maximum-tolerance impossibility is claimed. Both syntactic caps and all four resource bounds hold on every actual branch.

structured.error_model: Malformed-sample count among Q acquired copies. The proved guarantee requires every copy to be an independent ideal coset state; no behavior is promised for malformed copies.
